gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-glegoo: Open, rounded and unmistakable, Bellota Text draws each letter with a single steady line, while Glegoo stands taller below with big counters. Over a full page it reads smoothly.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-hanuman: Bellota Text opens with a bold, distinctive look, its curves left wide with no calligraphic shading. Hanuman follows with a high-waisted serif body, and that mix of display and tradition is the pair's real draw.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-kadwa: Kadwa reads large and friendly, its curves left open and its x-height generous. Bellota Text above it draws every join without any thick-to-thin shift, so a long page feels unhurried and clear.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noticia-text: Bellota Text looks bent from a steel rod. Noticia Text, a dignified text serif with big entrances into its curves and lowercase filling most of the letter height, supplies the literary weight that makes the pair memorable.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla reads tall and authoritative, its lowercase almost matching the capitals. Its e opens like a pried clasp, and set under the commanding Bellota Text, that classic serif gives the pair a striking height difference.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-pridi: Wiry and distinct, Bellota Text holds one pen angle and pressure throughout, while Pridi's small letters stand nearly capital-sized beside it. Paragraphs flow generously.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-scope-one: Bellota Text looks like bent tubing, open in its c, e and s shapes and commanding on top. Scope One does its best work below, with counters spilling into the space and a big x-height.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px reads bookish and clear, with big open counters in its tall a, e and s. Bellota Text above is bent from one length of tubing, and a long page of the classic serif below feels dignified and easy to follow.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-suwannaphum: Commanding Bellota Text looks cut from wire, with open c, e and s shapes. Suwannaphum answers with a serif body of high, squared-off lowercase, so the two feel like wire against woodblock.
gen-gf-boldonse-fs-rowan: Wide, loud and blueprint-straight, Boldonse spreads its constant lines across the top, then Rowan brings in friendly curves with generous openings. The classic serif is comfortable in small doses.
